abstracts.abstract: To enact sections 5507.01, 5507.02, and 5507.03 of the Revised Code to limit the use of automated license plate recognition systems and mass surveillance technology for one year, to repeal sections 5507.01, 5507.02, and 5507.03 of the Revised Code one year after the effective date, to abolish the General Assembly limitations governing such systems and technology at that time, and to name this act the 1984 No More Act.
